name: ArgaLink
description:
ArgaLink's Dynamo package that improves the display of abstract geometric objects in the 3D background preview.

It provides clearer and more readable visual representations of coordinate systems, planes and vectors, making geometric orientation, axis directions, plane normals and vector directions easier to identify.

The package is designed to support graph development, debugging, teaching and a better understanding of geometric relationships within Dynamo.
contents: VisualiseCoordinateSystem - Displays a coordinate system with clear, colour-coded X, Y and Z axes in Dynamo's 3D background preview., VisualisePlane - Displays a plane with enhanced visibility, including its normal direction, in Dynamo's 3D background preview., VisualiseVector - Displays a vector with enhanced visibility in Dynamo's 3D background preview, making its direction easier to identify.
